rationale: The DE core matches the reference closely: blind VST PCA and distance heatmap with an explicit outlier policy, a justified >=10-in-3 filter, median-of-ratios inside the model, ~condition with control releveled and the contrast named, Wald test with apeglm and BH at 0.05, and the n=3 power caveat carried forward. The enrichment correctly states that no curated zebrafish collection exists and takes the ortholog route to fgsea on human Hallmark with the ranking metric, universe, and size window stated, but it weakens the one-to-one requirement by collapsing many-to-one hits to the most significant zebrafish gene, leans on org.Dr.eg.db (which does not itself carry human orthologs) without naming a proper ortholog table version, and gives no Hallmark release. The report is thorough on versions, thresholds, counts and caveats, though the Ensembl release of the Danio rerio annotation is never named.
